sources.title: Annual Dubai Gastronomy Industry Report 2024
sources.publisher: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
sources.supporting_fact: Almost 1,200 new restaurant licences in 2024; 1,100+ diner survey; 2.5 restaurant visits/week; 18.72m overnight visitors; accommodation/food services +3.7% in first nine months of 2024 and 3.4% of GDP.
sources.evidence_quality: High for reported Dubai statistics; medium for demand inference.
sources.limitations: Restaurant licences are not active café locations; survey is consumer sentiment and DET methodology is only summarized on page.

sources.title: Over 34,000 food inspections conducted in first half of 2025
sources.supporting_fact: 34,700 inspections and approximately 2,336 new food establishments in H1 2025.
sources.limitations: Food-establishment scope is broader than cafés/restaurants; openings not net active stock.

sources.title: Over 26,000 food establishments operate Dubai
sources.publisher: Emirates News Agency quoting Dubai Municipality
sources.supporting_fact: Dubai Municipality official stated more than 26,000 food establishments operate in Dubai.
sources.limitations: Broad food-establishment definition; no activity-code breakdown or deduplication method.

sources.title: 1.1 million food products registered in Dubai Municipality Food Import and Export System
sources.supporting_fact: More than 23,400 food establishments operated in Dubai at publication.
sources.limitations: Older, broad category; not comparable directly to restaurant licences.

sources.title: Small to Medium Sized Enterprises Market Conduct Regulation
sources.supporting_fact: Federal SME thresholds: micro service <5 employees or <AED2m revenue; small service 6–50 employees or <AED20m revenue.
sources.limitations: Definition for regulation/segmentation, not count of SMEs or cafés.

sources.title: Foodics Pricing UAE
sources.supporting_fact: Public UAE monthly prices billed annually: AED199 Starter, AED375 Basic, AED556 Advanced; page mentions digital receipts, loyalty, BI and API integration.

sources.title: Integration Availability

sources.limitations: Entitlements, setup/hardware and API partner access need confirmation; vendor claims not independent.

sources.title: Unified Restaurant Operations Platform and Integrations

sources.limitations: No public price; no receipt-template rights shown.

sources.title: Deliverect Pricing

sources.limitations: No UAE amount; feature availability and implementation need quote.

sources.title: Queberry Queue Management
sources.supporting_fact: Offers queue management, WhatsApp queueing, digital signage and business analytics, serving UAE and regional markets.
sources.limitations: No public pricing or café-specific receipt integration evidence.

sources.title: PassKit Pricing Rate Card
sources.supporting_fact: Starts USD39.50/month; includes up to 250 multi-use and 250 single-use passes; tiered usage pricing.
sources.evidence_quality: High for current first-party self-serve rate statement.
sources.limitations: Taxes, team size, overage and enterprise/support requirements may change total.

sources.title: Loopy Loyalty Pricing
sources.supporting_fact: USD25/69/95 monthly for 1/3/10 locations, Apple/Google Wallet support and unlimited customers; annual USD250/690/950.
sources.limitations: Fair-use and product-fit constraints; not integrated pickup tracking evidence.

sources.title: Stampli – Digital Loyalty Cards for Apple & Google Wallet

sources.evidence_quality: Medium first-party product and pricing page.
sources.limitations: The same page claims a 2x typical repeat-visit lift, customer counts and testimonials without disclosed methodology, sample, comparison period or independent corroboration; these claims are not used as evidence.

sources.title: Digital Receipt Integration
sources.supporting_fact: Documents OAuth, account/receipt settings, customer-order created/updated webhooks, and closed/returned receipt-status logic.

sources.title: Choosing a Membership

sources.uncertainty: Feature behavior and permissions vary by device/account.
